headword: {連続殺人|れんぞくさつじん}
gloss: serial murder; serial killing; consecutive murders

definitions.gloss: serial murder; serial killing; consecutive murders

examples.japanese: {連続殺人|れんぞくさつじん}{事件|じけん}が{発生|はっせい}した。
{警察|けいさつ}は{連続殺人|れんぞくさつじん}の{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}を{逮捕|たいほ}した。
examples.english: The police arrested the suspect in the serial murders.

examples.japanese: このドラマは、{実際|じっさい}に{起|お}きた{連続殺人|れんぞくさつじん}{事件|じけん}をもとに{制作|せいさく}された。
examples.english: This drama was produced based on a serial murder case that actually happened.

notes:
A compound of {連続|れんぞく} (consecutive, serial) + {殺人|さつじん} (murder). Refers to a series of murders committed by the same perpetrator, typically with a cooling-off period between each killing. Commonly encountered in news reports and crime fiction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連続殺人|れんぞくさつじん}{事件|じけん}: serial murder case
- {連続殺人|れんぞくさつじん}{犯|はん}: serial killer
- {連続殺人|れんぞくさつじん}の{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}: serial murder suspect
- {連続殺人|れんぞくさつじん}の{捜査|そうさ}: serial murder investigation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {連続殺人犯|れんぞくさつじんはん}: serial killer (the perpetrator)
- {大量殺人|たいりょうさつじん}: mass murder (many victims in a single event, not spread over time)
- {殺人事件|さつじんじけん}: murder case (a single murder incident)
- シリアルキラー: serial killer (loanword; used in casual media discussions)
